{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates upward momentum during high-volatility regimes (e.g., Nov 2022), failing to capture the full magnitude of price spikes despite low sentiment scores.", "Forecast horizon shows significant lag in reacting to recent price spikes; true outcomes often exceed model projections by 5-10% within the first 7 days of a trend.", "Sentiment history (even at 0.00 or 0.25) fails to trigger upward adjustments in the model, suggesting sentiment is not being weighted as a leading indicator for bullish reversals.", "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias by smoothing out volatility; true outcomes display higher variance and sharper peaks than predicted linear trajectories.", "When recent history shows a clear uptick (e.g., >2% daily gain), the model fails to extrapolate this momentum, resulting in systematic under-forecasting of the 30-day high."]
